# Vanilla DQN: same network selects AND evaluates
y = r + gamma * max_a' Q(s', a'; theta_minus)

# Double DQN: online network selects, target evaluates
best_a  = argmax_a' Q(s', a'; theta)
y = r + gamma * Q(s', best_a; theta_minus)
caption: Decoupling selection from evaluation breaks the bias toward overestimated actions
